description: The `struct` declaration slot, without Sprites: `struct tell`/`ask`/`each` each raise `ol-reserved-word` under `["core-language", "data"]` -- Sprites, which owns these three names, is not claimed; Data is present because `struct` is a Data-profile form. Same three names as `reserved-procedures-without-sprites` and deliberately so: `spec/grammar.md:165` makes `define`/`to` and `struct` separate declaration slots, so this pins that the built-in-names rule reaches BOTH, and a change applied to procedure declarations alone leaves this fixture red. `"check": true`: checker diagnostics only -- no struct is ever instantiated and no events are produced. `message` is absent from the diagnostics below, as it is from its twin: the harness strips it from BOTH sides before comparing (`scripts/harness/index.mjs:977-983` projects every diagnostic to code/span/params/stage/severity), so supplying one here would be an assertion nothing can evaluate. Diagnostic identity is `code` plus `params` and "prose is presentation" (`spec/error-model.md:253`); the learner-facing wording is pinned by unit tests instead.
